help.search_content:
**Search** — type a table name, column name, or business term. Results show tables you are authorised to access, ranked by relevance.

**View details** — click any result to open the full table detail: columns, grants, lineage, data quality, and data sample.

**Bookmark** — star any table from its detail page to save it in Discovery → My Bookmarks.

**Comment** — scroll to the Comments section on any detail page to leave a question or note for the table steward.
help.discovery_content:
**Recommended** — tables with recent activity across your groups, excluding ones you have already viewed.

**New & Notable** — recently updated tables in your primary group.

**My Bookmarks** — tables and columns you have starred. Bookmark any table from its detail page.

**Recently Viewed** — the last 50 tables you opened, updated automatically as you browse.
help.health_content:
**Table coverage** — percentage of accessible tables that have a description. Higher is better.

**Column coverage** — percentage of columns across those tables with a business name or definition.

**Schema breakdown** — per-schema counts of total and described tables. Sort by coverage to find gaps.

**Priority actions** — up to 5 high-interaction tables that are missing descriptions. Click a table name to open its detail page and add a description.
help.glossary_content:
Browse and search business terms defined in Unity Catalog.

**Term detail** — select a term to see its definition, calculation logic, domain, steward, and linked tables.

**Concept map** — a visual graph of how the selected term relates to other tables and terms in the catalog.
help.catalog_content:
Drill down through the catalog hierarchy: catalog → schema → table.

Each table shows a data quality badge (A–F) when available. Click any table name to view its full metadata, columns, and lineage on the Search page.

Use Search for keyword-based lookup; use this browser when you know the schema you want to explore.
help.pipelines_content:
**Run** — trigger a registered pipeline. Each pipeline supports a single active run; the row updates with live progress while a run is in flight.

**Cancel** — stop an in-flight run. The backend (Databricks Jobs, ADF, or Azure DevOps) acknowledges the cancellation asynchronously.

**Define** — admins can add, edit, or remove pipeline definitions from the Admin tab. Each definition needs a backend, a target identifier, and the operators allowed to trigger it.
help.admin_ops_content:
**Pending reviews** — approve or reject column override proposals submitted by editors.

**Sync queue** — monitor the background worker that pushes metadata changes to Unity Catalog.

**CMS** — publish pinned announcements and featured tables in the Discovery feed.

**Pipelines** — register, trigger, and monitor data pipeline runs.
help.admin_insights_content:
**High-impact gaps** — popular tables missing descriptions or stewards, ranked by interaction count.

**Stewardship gaps** — all tables without an assigned steward email.

**DQ alerts** — tables currently failing automated data quality checks.
help.admin_audit_content:
Full append-only log of all metadata edits, approvals, and rejections with actor email, timestamp, and before/after values.

Comment log shows all comment and reply activity across the catalog.
